 Yemen’s Houthis claim attacks on Aramco facility in Riyadh, Khamis Mushait airbase, East-West pipeline in latest missile barrage targeting Saudi Arabia, whose authorities have yet to comment on the claims.
 Senior spokesman for Iran’s armed forces has warned that the response to any new attack by the United States would be “10 times” more severe after US President Donald Trump threatened that any future attack on Iran would be five times stronger than previous ones.
